source_claim: The official Crypton page defines six Piapro Characters and identifies them as Crypton virtual-singer software characters. Yamaha's official guideline separately names 29 Yamaha-created VOCALOID voicebank characters. The Fukase product page identifies one voicebank based on the real SEKAI NO OWARI vocalist and documents a separately commissioned character design. These checked routes distinguish bounded product/character sets but do not establish a single canonical HOME for this broad 88-member residual campaign; no blanket vocaloid HOME is inferred.

checked_routes.result: Crypton identifies exactly Hatsune Miku, Kagamine Rin, Kagamine Len, Megurine Luka, MEIKO, and KAITO as Piapro Characters; this does not cover the full VOCALOID residual campaign or imply membership for other products.

Yamaha's guideline names 29 characters created for Yamaha VOCALOID voicebank products and licenses character use in relation to those products or VOCALOID; it does not state a canonical Copyright HOME for the broader 88-member campaign.

The official product page identifies Fukase as a VOCALOID4 voicebank based on the SEKAI NO OWARI vocalist Fukase and describes a separately designed character; product affiliation alone does not establish a unique canonical HOME for this Character.

notes: Research outcome is campaign-level PARTIAL progress only. The campaign spans multiple producers, product lines, and character origins, so these three routes do not exhaust it. Checked distinct authority routes under the three-route DIRECT_AUTHORITY_RESEARCH ceiling; continue with another OPEN campaign and do not repeat these routes.
